rationale: Jamie's conviction that AI agents should automate repetitive construction project work aligns with Akshath's expertise in autonomous systems and motion planning—both are solving real-world automation challenges through robotics and AI. Akshath's deep technical background in SLAM, multi-agent systems, and control (Python, C++, ROS) could inform how Mastt's agentic AI platform orchestrates complex, coordinated workflows on construction sites, while Jamie's experience scaling AI solutions across 500+ projects offers practical context for deploying autonomous systems at scale.
intro_message: Jamie Cerexhe, meet Akshath Singhal — you're both building autonomous systems to handle repetitive, high-stakes work in physical domains, and your complementary expertise in agentic AI and robotics research could spark useful ideas around coordination and perception.
